courses.title: LLMOps Fundamentals for Engineering Managers
courses.description: LLMOps Fundamentals for Engineering Managers focuses on language model operations for people working toward a LLM Engineer role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces technical systems acumen, enough to apply alongside language model operations in real LLM Engineer work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to language model operations and show how technical systems acumen supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying language model operations to a real LLM Engineer scenario
Practicing language model operations through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to technical systems acumen
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Model Deployment Pipelines in Practice
courses.description: Model Deployment Pipelines in Practice goes beyond the basics of model deployment pipelines, for people already working toward a LLM Engineer role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in model deployment pipelines and want to go further.
